AlphaHoldem V5 clean-from-zero self-play trainer

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --device DEVICE
  --workers WORKERS
  --torch-threads TORCH_THREADS
                        Optional main-process Torch CPU thread bound for
                        diagnostics.
  --managed-deal-attempts
                        Reserve a durable fresh v2 deal namespace before each
                        worker start.
  --deal-attempt-registry DEAL_ATTEMPT_REGISTRY
  --assignment-replay-origin-checkpoint ASSIGNMENT_REPLAY_ORIGIN_CHECKPOINT
                        Explicit migration of an initial managed checkpoint
                        into an assignment replay origin.
  --deal-attempt-namespace DEAL_ATTEMPT_NAMESPACE
                        Optional explicit single-use namespace; reused
                        receipts fail closed.
  --hands-per-iter HANDS_PER_ITER
  --total-hands TOTAL_HANDS
                        Legacy transition-bearing hand target; not a full
                        physical hand count.
  --total-environment-hands TOTAL_ENVIRONMENT_HANDS
                        Optional physical completed-hand target, checked at
                        PPO boundaries; overrides the legacy target.
  --starting-stack STARTING_STACK
  --env-version {v6,v6legacyv4obs,v55,v4,v55cap1,v55cap1v4obs,v55v4obs,v55pfv2v4obs,v55preflopv2v4obs}
                        Training environment. v55 fixes the legacy V4/V5
                        action-history and raise-cap bugs.
  --v6-rebind-legacy-weights
                        Explicit NEW experiment migration: v6 contract, reset
                        optimizer and all hand counters; never a legacy run
                        resume.
  --norm-layer {bn,gn}  Network normalization. Use gn for GN BC/imitation
                        checkpoints.
  --lr LR
  --ppo-epochs PPO_EPOCHS
  --ppo-target-kl PPO_TARGET_KL
                        H6: after each completed PPO epoch, skip remaining
                        epochs when that epoch mean approx_kl is strictly
                        greater than this value. 0 disables early-stop and
                        preserves baseline behavior.
  --policy-advantage-clip POLICY_ADVANTAGE_CLIP
                        Symmetrically winsorize normalized actor advantages to
                        this absolute bound after normalization. Zero
                        preserves baseline.
  --policy-advantage-normalization {global,action,action_rms}
                        'action' whitens each sufficiently observed sampled
                        action. 'action_rms' equalizes action-wise RMS
                        magnitude while preserving bounded between-action mean
                        information.
  --action-normalization-min-rows ACTION_NORMALIZATION_MIN_ROWS
  --greedy-advantage-margin-coef GREEDY_ADVANTAGE_MARGIN_COEF
                        Default-off actor auxiliary loss: on positive-
                        advantage sampled actions that differ from legal
                        argmax, push the sampled logit above the current
                        greedy logit by --greedy-advantage-margin.
  --greedy-advantage-margin GREEDY_ADVANTAGE_MARGIN
  --source-greedy-margin-coef SOURCE_GREEDY_MARGIN_COEF
                        Default-off source-policy argmax preservation loss.
                        Preserve the frozen source legal-argmax margin unless
                        a different sampled action exceeds --source-greedy-
                        margin-release-advantage.
  --source-greedy-margin-max SOURCE_GREEDY_MARGIN_MAX
  --source-greedy-margin-release-advantage SOURCE_GREEDY_MARGIN_RELEASE_ADVANTAGE
  --source-greedy-risk-max-weight SOURCE_GREEDY_RISK_MAX_WEIGHT
                        Default 1 preserves the unweighted source-margin loss.
                        Values above 1 linearly upweight rows by public
                        pot/effective-stack fraction, without using outcomes
                        or private opponent state.
  --source-greedy-risk-full-pot-fraction SOURCE_GREEDY_RISK_FULL_POT_FRACTION
                        Pot/effective-stack fraction at which source-greedy
                        risk weight reaches --source-greedy-risk-max-weight.
  --source-greedy-risk-scale-release
                        Default off. Multiply the sampled-advantage release
                        threshold by the same public risk weight used for
                        source-margin credit.
  --action-q-hidden ACTION_Q_HIDDEN
  --action-q-advantage
  --action-q-loss-coef ACTION_Q_LOSS_COEF
  --action-q-dueling
  --action-q-residual-l2-coef ACTION_Q_RESIDUAL_L2_COEF
  --action-q-support-prior-rows ACTION_Q_SUPPORT_PRIOR_ROWS
                        Shrink action-Q policy credit for sparsely sampled
                        action slots by n_action/(n_action+prior_rows); Q
                        fitting is unchanged.
  --action-q-policy-mix ACTION_Q_POLICY_MIX
                        Fraction of delayed Action-Q advantage used by the PPO
                        actor. The default 1 preserves existing runs; values
                        below 1 blend in on-policy GAE to stabilize imperfect
                        Q credit.
  --action-q-counterfactual-dataset ACTION_Q_COUNTERFACTUAL_DATASET
                        Balanced BB/SB x flop/turn NPZ containing all-legal-
                        action Q targets. Only its stratified training split
                        enters optimization.
  --action-q-counterfactual-dataset-sha256 ACTION_Q_COUNTERFACTUAL_DATASET_SHA256
                        Required immutable SHA256 for the counterfactual
                        replay NPZ.
  --restart-counterfactual-replay-state
                        Explicit research branch: when preserving a resumed
                        optimizer, replace the inherited counterfactual
                        dataset with a different immutable dataset and restart
                        only its cursor, draw counter, and loss-decay clock at
                        the current lineage hand count. Model weights,
                        optimizer state, and environment-hand accounting
                        remain continuous.
  --action-q-counterfactual-loss-coef ACTION_Q_COUNTERFACTUAL_LOSS_COEF
                        Weight on centered all-legal-action Q replay loss.
                        Zero keeps all existing training behavior unchanged.
